rationale: B is better structured. Its pop2 helper removes the repeated pop/pop/error-check boilerplate and checks stack depth before consuming anything. Builtins are a plain map literal rather than a switch-returning-closures factory plus a dictionary that restates every name. A single resolve function holds the definition-time binding rule and documents it. Parsing works on the token stream with an explicit defining state, so definitions are not tied to line starts, and an unterminated definition is reported. A repeats the two-pop error handling eight times, and it only recognizes definitions when ':' starts a line. It also mixes eager binding with a late-binding fallback for undefined words, which makes the semantics inconsistent. B's push returning an always-nil error is a minor oddity, but overall B is cleaner, more idiomatic and more robust.
